simple.summary: אֲוֵרָה (ʼăvêrâh) means a stall First listed occurrence: 2Chr 32 28.

definitions.full: H220. averah [ אֻרְיָה ] noun feminine manger, crib (Aramaic אוּדְיָא , , Arabic stall , etc., Vulgar Arabic = manager Mohit 19. 15 (GFM, privately), compare Lane 51c ; Assyrian urû Dl BAS i. 211 ) — Plural אֻרָוֺת 2Chr 32:28 (Aramaic form for אֳרָוֺת ; compare Lag BN 172 ); construct אֻרְוֺת 1Kin 5:6 , ֻארְיוֺת 2Chr 9:25 ; crib of horses 1Kin 5:6 (app. in enumeration horses themselves, English head , or span , compare also 2Chr 9:25 with 1Kin 10:26 ; So Th MV, but text here dubious. compare Klo), hence 2Chr 9:25 ; of any animals ( כלבֿהמה ) 32:28 (on ׳לַאֲ see Add.). **Also plural אֲוֵרוֺת 32:28 b (read probably ᵑ9 ᵐ5 לָעֲדָרִים Kit Benz and others).
